data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [I ordered two Pamela chairs on 5/22/23](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/654acfe32cfa451056911e1d)
I ordered two Pamela chairs on 5/22/23. I earned 1438 points from this purchase. When I went online to purchase something it indicated that I did not have points. I’ve emailed the company a few times and still have not received a response. I found one phone number online, but was not able to get through, it was a recorded message about privacy. The number on my American Express bill for the Lulu and Georgia had a recorded message that did not indicate it was the company, it just said to call back. I then went on a an email I received from the company that clearly stated my reward points with a box that said shop now and when I activated that the screen went blank. I tried to locate a phone number for Lulu and Georgia to no avail. So I emailed the company several times and have not heard back. How can you be in business and not have a customer service phone number? I intend to get in touch with American Express and let them know that the phone number that they post on invoices is bogus. I hope the $1800 I spent on two chairs is not in vain. If anything ever happens to these chairs, there’s no way to get in touch with the company. I think this is terrible.

November 6, 2023

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Nov 9, 2023

Hi Carmel,

We appreciate your feedback. Upon investigating your concerns, we found that one of our agents has already responded and provided you with an update promptly. Although we don't operate a live phone number, our voicemail clearly states to email us for any inquiries. Alternatively, if you prefer real-time assistance, we do offer a chat service from 9 AM to 5 PM PST, where our live agents can further assist you.
